title: Gap analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (CFO, VP Operations, IT Manager, SCADA and Automation Supervisor, Network Administrator, Production Accounting Manager, HR Manager, 4 Production Controllers, 2 automation technicians, the SCADA integrator's lead engineer)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each CSF 2.0 outcome is carried out today. The CFO states that no security metrics are reported, there is no supplier security process or pre-contract assessment, and supplier incidents are not planned for. The IT Manager states that supplier access is removed when someone notices the work has ended, no threat intelligence sources are used, no event correlation is done, and no tabletop exercises or restore tests have been run, which the VP Operations confirms. The SCADA and Automation Supervisor states that there is no OT asset list, no process for vendor security advisories, no OT security training, OT patches are applied ad hoc, field hardware is replaced on failure, supplier activity is not monitored, and there is no written procedure to rebuild SCADA or check restored systems. Automation technicians state that logic changes are not reviewed by a second person and update files are not verified. The Production Accounting Manager states that there is no data inventory. The Network Administrator states that corporate firewall alerts are reviewed ad hoc and nothing is monitored in OT
